tagline: One of the largest surface transportation, delivery, and logistics companies in North America.
hero_kpi_rationale: JBHT operates in the surface logistics and transportation sector. The operating margin of 7.2% in 2025 (versus 6.9% in 2024, representing a 4.1% increase) is the most relevant KPI as it reflects operational efficiency and the company's ability to generate profits from its core activities of intermodal, dedicated services, integrated capacity solutions, final mile delivery, and trucking.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage of total operating revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin indicates the company's ability to generate profits from its core transportation and logistics operations.
kpis.signal: Measures the profitability of core operations before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: Total Operating Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by all operating activities of the company.
kpis.description: Total operating revenues measure the aggregate revenues generated by five business segments: intermodal, dedicated services, integrated capacity solutions, final mile delivery services, and trucking.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of commercial performance and company size.

kpis.name: Net Earnings
kpis.explanation: Net income after deduction of all expenses, taxes, and interest, expressed as a percentage of total operating revenues.
kpis.description: Net earnings represent the company's final profit after all operating expenses, interest, and income taxes.
kpis.signal: Measures the company's final net profitability.

kpis.name: Operating Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of operating expenses to total operating revenues, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Operating ratio measures the percentage of revenue consumed by operating expenses. A lower ratio indicates better operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of operational efficiency in the transportation industry.

kpis.name: Insurance and Claims Expense
kpis.explanation: Total expenses related to insurance and claims management, expressed as a percentage of total operating revenues.
kpis.description: Insurance and claims expenses include premiums for liability coverage, property damage, vehicle accidents, and employee injury benefits.
kpis.signal: Reflects rising insurance costs and claims frequency.

kpis.name: Salaries, Wages and Benefits
kpis.explanation: Total expenses related to employee compensation and benefits, expressed as a percentage of total operating revenues.
kpis.description: Salaries, wages, and benefits represent the largest expense category after purchased transportation and reflect labor costs.
kpis.signal: Major operating cost reflecting wage pressures and employee benefits.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 7.93 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 1.47 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the 7 most recent fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.9 $ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the 4 most recent fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.171 Bn $ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the 4 most recent fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 28.6% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the 8 most recent fiscal years of 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 7.19 Bn $ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the 8 most recent fiscal years of 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of 0.598 Bn $ in the latest year.

risks.title: Dependence on a Small Number of Large Customers
risks.score_rationale: Risk is highlighted at the beginning of the 'Risks Related to Our Business' section and concerns the potential loss of customers representing 33% of revenues. The language emphasizes a 'material and adverse effect'. Customer concentration is stable versus prior year. High weighting for the Competition category.

risks.title: Cyberattacks or System Failures
risks.score_rationale: Positioned among the later risks but with strong language: 'material and adverse effect', mention of ransomware, data loss, and acknowledged prior incidents. Evolving threats (AI, phishing). Cybersecurity category heavily weighted. Risk trending upward.

risks.title: Increase in Insurance Costs and Claims
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes 'substantial increases' in liability costs, exceeding insurance layers. Repeated mention of impacts on results. Trend toward higher premiums observed in 2025 (6.7% progression). Capital category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Rapid Fluctuations in Fuel Costs
risks.score_rationale: Risk is moderate as it is offset by an automatic fuel surcharge program. However, compensation delays and unrecovered costs (empty miles, idle time) are cited. No derivative coverage in 2025. Macro category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Driver Shortage and Personnel Constraints
risks.score_rationale: Direct language: 'could affect our profitability and growth'. Mention of wage pressures and dependence on third-party carriers. Structural risk in the industry. Industrial category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Reclassification of Independent Contractors
risks.score_rationale: Alarming language: 'substantial increase in costs', tax liabilities, social responsibilities, and retroactive assessments. Specific mention of California and stricter tests. Regulation category with high potential impact.

risks.title: Pandemics or Global Health Crises
risks.score_rationale: Systemic risk cited with multiple effects: customer disruptions, shortages, port restrictions. Uncertain but concerned language ('significant effect'). Post-Covid context reinforces credibility. Geopolitical category moderately weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: JBHT does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report. Technology mentions are limited to cybersecurity and information systems. J.B. Hunt 360 is an online platform offering supply chain visibility and transparency, but without explicit AI components.
